enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed with eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Occasional shift of body position. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on clothes. Brush teeth. Turn off light.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Pour cereal and milk into bowl. Eat with spoon. Boil water. Make coffee. Drink coffee. Rinse dishes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit. Look at phone. Check messages. Listen to music. Get off at Clayton. Walk to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending business lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Sit at desk. Take out laptop. Open laptop. Take notes. Listen to lecturer. Raise hand to ask question. Participate in tutorial. Discuss with group. Write on whiteboard. Take break. Drink water. Use phone. Pack up. Leave lecture hall.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus and chatting with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Buy sandwich. Sit at table with classmates. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Talk to classmate: 'How was your weekend?' Laugh. Drink water. Check phone. Throw away trash. Say goodbye. Walk to library.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library and working on group assignments
enriched_activities.desc: Enter library. Find table. Sit down. Open laptop. Open textbook. Read notes. Type on keyboard. Highlight text. Discuss assignment with group. Share screen. Write on notebook. Borrow book from shelf. Print document. Pack backpack. Leave library.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport from Clayton to Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Reply to message. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk to store.

enriched_activities.activity: Working part-time retail shift at Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter store. Clock in. Put on uniform. Greet customers: 'Hi, how can I help you?' Fold clothes. Arrange shelves. Operate cash register. Scan items. Take payment. Bag items. Answer phone. Clean counter. Restock shelves. Take break. Eat snack. Clock out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from Chadstone by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit. Look at phone. Listen to music. Check messages. Reply to friend. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk to front door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place container inside. Set timer. Press start. Wait. Take out container. Stir food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Rinse container. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a quick shower
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Undress. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing lecture notes and finishing coursework on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Open lecture notes. Read notes. Type summary. Save file. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off light.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Sleep.
